title: Mohsin Naqvi Details Islamabad's F-9 Park Upgrade Plans
excerpt: Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi has announced that no trees will be cut during the upcoming upgrade of Islamabad's F-9 Park.
body_html:
Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi has provided key details regarding the planned upgrade of Islamabad's F-9 Park.

According to the announcement, the project will be executed without cutting a single tree in the park.
